terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.layoutSubtitle: Learn about the terms and conditions of using ISWO Academy
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using ISWO Academy. By using our services, you agree to be legally bound by these terms.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using ISWO Academy, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use our services. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time, and your continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of such changes.

userAccount.title: 2. User Registration and Account
userAccount.content: To access certain features of the platform, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate and up-to-date information during registration. ISWO Academy reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

serviceUse.title: 3. Use of Service
serviceUse.content: We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, and non-transferable license to access and use ISWO Academy for personal educational purposes. You may not: (a) copy, modify, or distribute content without authorization, (b) use the service for illegal activities, (c) attempt to access restricted areas of the platform, (d) interfere with the operation of the service, or (e) use bots or automated systems without express permission.

intellectualProperty.title: 4. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: All content on ISWO Academy, including text, graphics, logos, videos, and software, is protected by intellectual property rights. Instructors retain rights to the content they create but grant ISWO Academy a license to distribute it. Students may view content for personal and educational use but cannot redistribute it commercially.

payments.title: 5. Payments and Subscriptions
payments.content: Some courses and features require payment. Prices are subject to change with prior notice. Subscriptions automatically renew until you cancel them. You can cancel at any time from your account dashboard. Refunds will be processed according to our refund policy, generally within 14 days of purchase if you have not consumed more than 20% of the course.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: ISWO Academy is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the service will be error-free or uninterrupted. We are not responsible for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the platform. Our total liability is limited to the amount you have paid for the service in the last 12 months.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.layoutSubtitle: Your privacy is our priority. Learn how we protect your data
privacy.intro: At ISWO Academy, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.

dataCollection.title: 1. Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, profile photo, and learning preferences when you create an account. We also automatically collect information about your use of the platform, including courses visited, learning progress, study time, and device data (IP address, browser type, operating system). We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: We use your information to: provide and improve our educational services, personalize your learning experience, process payments and subscriptions, send you updates about your courses, communicate with you about your account, analyze platform usage to improve it, comply with legal obligations, and protect the security of our users. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

dataSharing.title: 3. Sharing Your Information
dataSharing.content: We share your information only in limited circumstances: with instructors of courses you're enrolled in (name, progress, and activity), with service providers that help us operate the platform (payment processors, email services, hosting), when required by law or to protect our rights, and with your explicit consent for other specific purposes. All our providers are contractually obligated to protect your information.

dataSecurity.title: 4. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes data encryption in transit (SSL/TLS), password encryption, firewalls, continuous security monitoring, and restricted access to personal information only for authorized employees. However, no method of internet transmission is 100% secure.

userRights.title: 5. Your Rights and Choices
userRights.content: You have the right to: access your personal information, correct inaccurate data, request deletion of your account and associated data, export your data in a portable format, object to the processing of your information, withdraw your consent at any time, and opt out of marketing communications. You can exercise these rights from your account settings or by contacting us directly.

internationalTransfers.title: 6. International Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: ISWO Academy operates globally and may transfer your information to servers located in different countries. By using our services, you consent to these transfers. We ensure that any international transfer complies with applicable data protection laws, including the use of approved standard contractual clauses and adequate safeguards to protect your information.

cookies.subtitle: Information about the cookies we use
cookies.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.

cookies.performance: Performance cookies: Help us understand how you use the site
